This yields exactly the quotient weight type, n-term HJ chain, canonical index 2 and age minimum 1/2. The toric orbit correspondence proves exhaustion of codimension-two singular components. Exact checker reconstructs all edges and determinants for n=3..9. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.
